title: Constant integer density on the support near p makes p a regular point of a minimizing cycle
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ with n ≥ 1, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P (ℝ^P := Euclid P), every T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) that is minimizing in U (IsMinimizingIn T U) with ∂T = 0 in U (BoundaryVanishes T), every p ∈ spt T, every k ∈ ℕ and every δ > 0 such that Θⁿ(μ_T, y) = k (HasMassDensity T y k) for every y ∈ spt T ∩ B_δ(p): p ∈ reg T (p ∈ regularSet T, Simon 7.4.1).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (p : Euclid P) (k : ℕ) (δ : ℝ), 1 ≤ n → IsOpen U → IsMinimizingIn T U → BoundaryVanishes T → p ∈ T.support → 0 < δ → (∀ y ∈ T.support, y ∈ ball p δ → HasMassDensity T y k) → p ∈ regularSet T
